base_model_group_safe_test.note: single leave-material-out split; conformal COVERAGE does not depend on this R2 (distribution-free guarantee)

dataset.name: NIST CORR-DATA (Dow Chemical Co.) derived reference

hostile_null_shuffled_labels_alpha_0.10.definition: train labels permuted (fixed seed) -> deliberately broken base learner; conformal coverage must STILL meet target because the guarantee needs only exchangeability, not base-learner skill (Lei 2018)

methods.exchangeability: GROUP-safe: train/cal/test disjoint by MATERIAL (leave-material-out); cal and test are disjoint alloys
methods.normalized_conformal: Papadopoulos-Gammerman-Vovk 2008; Lei et al 2018 sec5, score=|y-mu(x)|/sigma(x)

mondrian_by_magnitude_tercile_alpha_0.10.rationale: rate-magnitude terciles stress conditional coverage; a global interval typically under-covers the high-rate tail

mondrian_by_marine_chloride_alpha_0.10.rationale: marine/chloride environments are the in-scope coating context; category-conditional coverage guards against marginal coverage hiding a stratum failure

target_interpretation: bare metal/alloy SUBSTRATE corrosion rate; NOT organic epoxy-amine COATING-barrier performance (scope ceiling held)

verdict.does_not_establish: A validated organic COATING-barrier ranking. This is a calibrated environmental-severity (substrate corrosion-rate) uncertainty model only; it grants no coating-barrier, batch-release, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
verdict.finding: Group-safe (leave-material-out) split conformal delivers distribution-free marginal coverage at the 0.90 and 0.80 targets on the rights-clean NIST CORR-DATA corrosion-rate model; the coverage guarantee holds even when the base learner is destroyed by label shuffling (intervals simply inflate), which is the red-team defence that coverage does not depend on R2. Mondrian category- and magnitude-conditional coverage is reported to expose any stratum where the marginal guarantee hides under-coverage.
verdict.relation_to_point_baseline: Extends corr-rate-qspr-v1 (point estimate + cluster-bootstrap RMSE CI) with per-prediction calibrated intervals; same features and HistGBM config.
verdict.scope_honesty: Bare-metal/alloy substrate corrosion (same ceiling as corr-rate-qspr-v1), restricted to leave-material-out AD; first calibrated interval receipt for the module on a RIGHTS-CLEAN dataset (the prior Polyverse conformal work is CONTEXT_ONLY / rights-quarantined and not scored).
